evidence.CANHLIFE: Canara HSBC Life Insurance is an Indian life insurance company, headquartered in Gurugram. In 2008, Canara HSBC Life Insurance was a JV between Canara Bank (51%), HSBC Insurance (Asia Pacific) Holdings Limited (26%) and PNB (23%). In 2022, the company renamed itself as Canara HSBC Life Insurance after the exit of its third partner, PNB. Business Profile Canara HSBC Life Insurance Company Limited is a bank-led private life insurer jointly promoted by Canara Bank (51%) and HSBC Insurance. The company offers a comprehensive range of individual and group insurance solutions, including savings, protection, retirement, ULIPs, annuity, and government-backed schemes.
evidence.GICRE: General Insurance Corporation of India is engaged in the business of Reinsurance.(Source : 201903 Annual Report Page No:87) History - Post Independence, Government of India (GOI) took over 55 Indian insurance companies and the undertakings of 52 insurers carrying on general insurance business. Later in Nov 1972, GOI incorporated General Insurance Corporation of India (GIC) to look after the above entities which were merged into 4 companies namely, National Insurance Company Limited, The New India Assurance Company Limited, The Oriental Insurance Company Limited, United India Insurance Company Limited (which is also a wholly-owned subsidiary of GIC).
